links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of general-purpose LLMs on pediatric CXR classification
links.effect: Average diagnostic accuracy was 31%, consistent with chance-level performance in a three-choice task; concordance with human experts did not exceed 49% for any model.
links.quote: Across all models and CXR types, the average diagnostic accuracy was 31%, consistent with chance-level performance in a three-choice classification task.

screen.reason: Evaluated the diagnostic performance of general-purpose multimodal LLMs on a retrospective benchmark dataset of pediatric chest radiographs compared to human expert consensus, without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
